m4-circular2.title: Circular arrangement (Hard)
m4-circular2.html:
Circular arrangement

Seven players sit around a round card table, equally spaced and facing the centre. Each plays for one of three clubs — Riverside, Hilltop, Old Town — with three from Riverside and two from each of the others. "Immediately to the left" is from the seated person's own point of view.

The following is known:

  • Rhea and Ela sit next to each other.
  • Ela sits immediately to the left of Nakul.
  • Omkar sits immediately to the left of Charu.
  • Nakul and Ira have different clubs.
  • Manav and Ela have the same club.
  • Along the shorter way round, exactly two people sit between Nakul and Ira.
  • Rhea's club is not Riverside.
  • Along the shorter way round, exactly one person sits between Manav and Omkar.
  • Charu and Rhea have the same club.
  • Ira's club is not Riverside.

Tournament

Five neighbourhood futsal sides — Rovers, Strikers, Comets, Titans, Wanderers — played a single round-robin: each pair met exactly once. A win was worth 3 points, a draw 2 points, and a loss 0.

The following is known:

  • Rovers finished with 7 points.
  • Wanderers won exactly three matches.
  • Strikers finished with 5 points.
  • Wanderers finished with 9 points.
  • Strikers and Titans drew.
  • Titans finished with 9 points.
